answer: An agent market selling yarrow for a summit garden and an oasis nursery pays a fixed referral commission per completed sale, split across the entire referral chain rather than paid anew at each hop. The contract escrows that commission from the sale proceeds and caps total payouts at that amount, with no signup rewards. Inserting a thousand alias referrers cannot enlarge the commission; self-purchases still fund it from their own proceeds. This prevents sybil chains from draining the referral budget.
